args.title: Saltmarsh Foods: Warehouse automation in 2026 (newsletter + article + companion)
args.body:
Three-bullet summary of Saltmarsh Foods' "Warehouse automation in 2026" newsletter, its linked article, and the article's companion piece:

- Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts (article).
- Integration took twice as long as planned (article).
- The biggest saving was fewer mis-picks (companion piece).

Sources:
- Newsletter: newsletter@saltmarsh.example, "Warehouse automation in 2026"
- Article: https://blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/warehouse
- Companion: https://insights.saltmarsh.example/warehouse/companion
